licence: CC0 1.0 (synthesised in this repo, no samples used)
loudnessNote: Every file is peak-normalised to about -3 dBFS (UI ticks and short swishes -6 to -8 dBFS; risers, fanfares and fireworks are a little louder in perceived level). Dense or tonal sounds are level-capped so loudness stays roughly even across the set. Play at `volume` (0.0-1.0) times the user's master volume.

sounds.name: Iris open
sounds.desc: A circle grows from the exact tap point and reveals the next screen.

sounds.name: Blade wipe
sounds.desc: The new screen slides in behind a shiny steel edge, like a blade passing over.

sounds.name: Curtain split
sounds.desc: The old screen splits down the middle and slides out to both sides.

sounds.name: Venetian blinds
sounds.desc: Eight vertical slats rotate to show the new screen.

sounds.name: Pixel bloom
sounds.desc: Square pixels pop up in random order until the new screen is complete.

sounds.name: Diamond open
sounds.desc: A diamond-shaped window opens from the centre.

sounds.name: Zoom through
sounds.desc: The old screen zooms past the camera while the new one settles from slightly large.

sounds.name: 3D card flip
sounds.desc: The screen flips like a card around a vertical axis.

sounds.name: Parallax push
sounds.desc: The new screen pushes the old one away, background layers move at different speeds.

sounds.name: Drop and bounce
sounds.desc: The new screen drops from above, squashes, and bounces once.

sounds.name: Blade swing
sounds.desc: The new screen swings out from a hinge like a pocket-knife blade opening, with a click at the end.

sounds.name: Camera shutter
sounds.desc: Seven shutter blades close over the old screen and open on the new one.

sounds.name: Film-strip roll
sounds.desc: The old screen rolls up like a film strip and the new one rolls in.

sounds.name: Page curl
sounds.desc: The corner of the old screen curls back to reveal the new one.

sounds.name: Water ripple
sounds.desc: A ripple spreads from the tap and bends the old screen into the new one.

sounds.name: Glitch slice
sounds.desc: Horizontal slices slide sideways with a quick colour split, then settle.

sounds.name: Liquid morph
sounds.desc: The tapped button melts into a blob that spreads and becomes the new screen.

sounds.name: Ink splash
sounds.desc: Ink splashes from the tap and floods the screen, then the new screen shows through.

sounds.name: Confetti sweep
sounds.desc: A wave of confetti sweeps across and leaves the new screen behind it.

sounds.name: Clock wipe
sounds.desc: A clock hand sweeps around and reveals the new screen behind it.

sounds.name: Spiral twist
sounds.desc: The old screen twists into a spiral and the new one unwinds.

sounds.name: Gooey merge
sounds.desc: Blobs of colour merge like liquid metal and become the new screen.

sounds.name: Shatter and assemble
sounds.desc: The old screen cracks into tiles that fly away while the new tiles fly in.

sounds.name: Mosaic resolve
sounds.desc: The new screen starts as big blocks and sharpens to full resolution.

sounds.name: Sunrise sweep
sounds.desc: A band of warm light sweeps up the screen and the new screen glows in.

sounds.name: Card shuffle
sounds.desc: The old screen becomes a card, shuffles into a deck, and the new card is dealt on top.

sounds.name: Tummy portal
sounds.desc: A round portal opens from Pip's tummy and the new screen grows out of it.

sounds.name: Pip pulls the screen
sounds.desc: Pip runs across the screen pulling the new screen behind him like a curtain.

sounds.name: Unzip
sounds.desc: A zipper runs down the screen and the new screen is behind it.

sounds.name: Sticker peel
sounds.desc: The old screen peels off like a sticker from one corner.

sounds.name: Tool flip
sounds.desc: Pip's blade quiff flips to the tool's icon, the icon scales up to fill the screen and becomes the new page.

sounds.name: Vortex
sounds.desc: The old screen is sucked into a point and the new one blooms from the same point.

sounds.name: Drop into tray
sounds.desc: The result card drops into a tray at the bottom and the tray bounces.

sounds.name: Paper plane
sounds.desc: The result folds into a paper plane and glides to the gallery icon.

sounds.name: Confetti cannon
sounds.desc: Two cannons from the bottom corners fire confetti over the result.

sounds.name: Coin shower
sounds.desc: XP coins rain down and fly into the XP bar.

sounds.name: Curve to gallery
sounds.desc: The thumbnail shrinks and travels along a curve into the gallery icon, which wiggles.

sounds.name: SAVED stamp
sounds.desc: A big SAVED stamp slams on the result with a small shockwave.

sounds.name: Zip pack
sounds.desc: Several files squeeze together and a zipper closes them into one bundle.

sounds.name: Mailbox
sounds.desc: The thumbnail flies into a mailbox, the flag lifts.

sounds.name: Safe lock
sounds.desc: A shield with a padlock closes over the file. Used for privacy jobs.

sounds.name: Gift box
sounds.desc: The result is wrapped in a ribbon and the box opens to show it.

sounds.name: Rocket launch
sounds.desc: The result sits in a small rocket that blasts off to the share target.

sounds.name: Balloon pop
sounds.desc: A balloon carries the result up, then pops into confetti.

sounds.name: Sparkle sweep
sounds.desc: A diagonal shine sweeps across the thumbnail and sparkles pop.

sounds.name: Ring close and pop
sounds.desc: The progress ring closes, flashes, and a check mark bursts out of it.

sounds.name: Ink check
sounds.desc: A thick check mark draws itself with an ink stroke.

sounds.name: Polaroid print
sounds.desc: The result prints out like an instant photo and slowly develops.

sounds.name: Vault door
sounds.desc: A round vault door closes with spinning bolts. Used for location removal.

sounds.name: Pip catches it
sounds.desc: Pip jumps and catches the result in both hands and holds it up.

sounds.name: Number reel
sounds.desc: The final size digits roll like a slot machine and lock into place.

sounds.name: Fireworks
sounds.desc: Three fireworks burst behind the result.

sounds.name: Bubble float
sounds.desc: Bubbles lift the result up and pop one by one.

sounds.name: Magnet pull
sounds.desc: A magnet pulls the file onto the Save button, small sparks fly.

sounds.name: Arrow drill
sounds.desc: A download arrow drills down through the card into the tray.

sounds.name: Stack and tidy
sounds.desc: Loose results stack into a neat pile and straighten up.

sounds.name: Lightning snap
sounds.desc: A quick flash and a lightning bolt strike the Save button. Used for very fast jobs.

sounds.name: Wax seal
sounds.desc: A wax seal stamps the result. Used for cleaned and private files.

sounds.name: Origami crane
sounds.desc: The result folds into a crane and flies off the screen.

sounds.name: Floppy stamp
sounds.desc: A retro floppy-disk icon stamps onto the result in pixels.

sounds.name: Mini chest
sounds.desc: A tiny chest pops up, opens, and the result rises out of it.

sounds.name: Glow badge
sounds.desc: A soft glow pulses around the result and a ribbon unrolls with the file size.

sounds.name: Converging streams
sounds.desc: Several mini bars race at different speeds then merge into one.

sounds.name: Liquid fill
sounds.desc: A wavy liquid fills the track and sloshes.

sounds.name: Orbit
sounds.desc: Little dots orbit a ring that fills as they gather.

sounds.name: Tile flip
sounds.desc: A grid of tiles flips to the accent colour in random order.

sounds.name: Comets
sounds.desc: Comets race along the rail and dive into a bright head.

sounds.name: Warp
sounds.desc: Stars streak outward faster as progress grows.

sounds.name: Pip runs
sounds.desc: Tiny Pip runs along the bar and leaves a coloured trail.

sounds.name: Blade slice
sounds.desc: A blade slices the photo into strips that slide together into one.

sounds.name: Zipper
sounds.desc: The bar is a zipper that closes as progress grows.

sounds.name: Gears
sounds.desc: Small gears spin and all feed one big gear.

sounds.name: Fireflies
sounds.desc: Fireflies swarm toward the end of the bar.

sounds.name: Charging segments
sounds.desc: Segments light up like a battery and the last one pulses.

sounds.name: Photo press
sounds.desc: Pip hugs the photo and squeezes it like an accordion until it is small.

sounds.name: Belt tightening
sounds.desc: Pip tightens his belt a notch at a time while the photo gets slimmer.

sounds.name: Vacuum seal
sounds.desc: Pip sucks the air out of a bag holding the photo until it hugs the photo.

sounds.name: Kneading
sounds.desc: Pip kneads the photo like dough and it folds smaller each time.

sounds.name: Tiny steamroller
sounds.desc: Pip drives a toy steamroller over the photo and the file size drops.

sounds.name: Grape stomp
sounds.desc: Pip jumps up and down on a pile of pixels and juice squirts out.

sounds.name: Balloon deflate
sounds.desc: Pip holds a balloon labelled MB. It deflates with a raspberry noise to KB.

sounds.name: Weight lifting
sounds.desc: Pip lifts a heavy weight labelled MB. It gets lighter every rep and ends as a feather.

sounds.name: Origami fold
sounds.desc: Pip folds the photo into a smaller and smaller square.

sounds.name: Orange squeeze
sounds.desc: Pip squeezes a pixel orange and the extra bytes drip out.

sounds.name: Snip frame
sounds.desc: Pip snips a frame out of the air with his blade and the photo slides inside.

sounds.name: Measuring tape
sounds.desc: Pip pulls a tape across the photo and nods at the exact numbers.

sounds.name: Hammer the frame
sounds.desc: Pip hammers four nails into a wooden frame around the photo.

sounds.name: Chalk line
sounds.desc: Pip snaps a chalk line along the crop edge and blows the dust.

sounds.name: Laser cut
sounds.desc: Pip cuts the crop outline with a tiny laser, sparks fly.

sounds.name: Cookie cutter
sounds.desc: Pip presses a cookie cutter on the photo and lifts out the crop.

sounds.name: Sculptor chisel
sounds.desc: Pip chips away the extra photo with a chisel until the frame shape is left.

sounds.name: Hang on wall
sounds.desc: Pip hangs the cropped photo on a wall and straightens it with a squint.

sounds.name: Carpenter saw
sounds.desc: Pip saws along the line, a tiny sawdust cloud puffs.

sounds.name: Stretch and pinch
sounds.desc: Pip stretches the photo with both hands and pinches to the right size.

sounds.name: Format juggling
sounds.desc: Pip juggles JPG, PNG and WebP blocks and catches only the one you chose.

sounds.name: Magic hat
sounds.desc: Pip taps a hat with a wand and the photo comes out in the new format.

sounds.name: Blender
sounds.desc: Pip drops the photo in a blender and pours out a new format.

sounds.name: Costume change
sounds.desc: The photo steps behind a curtain, Pip counts to three, it steps out in a new outfit.

sounds.name: Format rally
sounds.desc: Pip hits the photo like a tennis ball between two format boxes.

sounds.name: Chameleon
sounds.desc: Pip changes colour from the old format colour to the new format colour.

sounds.name: Conveyor belt
sounds.desc: Pip stands at a conveyor belt and stamps each file on its way.

sounds.name: Translator
sounds.desc: Pip wears a headset and translates between two format flags.

sounds.name: Pottery wheel
sounds.desc: The photo spins on a pottery wheel and Pip shapes it into the new format.

sounds.name: Shape-shifter
sounds.desc: Pip flips through his own tools and the photo copies each shape.

sounds.name: Detective
sounds.desc: Pip puts on a hat and checks the photo with a magnifier.

sounds.name: Radar
sounds.desc: A radar sweeps around Pip until a pin blips on the photo.

sounds.name: Treasure map
sounds.desc: Pip unfolds a map and puts his finger on the place the photo was taken.

sounds.name: Eraser
sounds.desc: Pip rubs a big eraser over the location tag until it is gone.

sounds.name: Cut the thread
sounds.desc: The location is a thread tied to the photo. Pip snips it.

sounds.name: Sponge wash
sounds.desc: Pip scrubs the photo with a sponge and little data bubbles float away.

sounds.name: Dust vacuum
sounds.desc: Pip vacuums dust clouds labelled EXIF and GPS.

sounds.name: Spy shades
sounds.desc: Pip puts on shades, looks left and right, and slips the photo into a folder.

sounds.name: Ninja hide
sounds.desc: Pip hides behind the photo and peeks, then gives a thumbs up.

sounds.name: Padlock polish
sounds.desc: Pip polishes a padlock until it shines, then clicks it shut.

sounds.name: Clapper board
sounds.desc: Pip snaps a clapper board shut and shouts action.

sounds.name: Projector crank
sounds.desc: Pip cranks an old projector and frames flicker on the wall.

sounds.name: Flip book
sounds.desc: Pip flips a flip-book with his thumb, the frames run past.

sounds.name: Popcorn
sounds.desc: Pip eats popcorn while the video is processed and catches a kernel in his mouth.

sounds.name: DJ scratch
sounds.desc: Pip scratches the timeline like a record.

sounds.name: Timeline trim
sounds.desc: Pip snips the timeline at both ends and the middle part glows.

sounds.name: Frame juggling
sounds.desc: Pip juggles tiny frames, one after another, and drops none.

sounds.name: Wave surfing
sounds.desc: Pip surfs a wave made of the video frames.

sounds.name: Fast forward
sounds.desc: Pip runs in fast forward with speed lines and a blur.

sounds.name: Boomerang
sounds.desc: Pip throws a boomerang that carries the clip and catches it as it comes back.

sounds.name: QR laser
sounds.desc: Pip scans a QR code with a red laser from his eyes and it beeps.

sounds.name: Paint palette
sounds.desc: Pip holds a palette and dabs the colours he found in the photo.

sounds.name: Pixel builder
sounds.desc: Pip places pixel blocks one by one to build a QR code or icon.

sounds.name: Icon stamp
sounds.desc: Pip stamps the same icon in many sizes.

sounds.name: Rainbow painter
sounds.desc: Pip paints a rainbow gradient with a wide brush.

sounds.name: Eyedropper
sounds.desc: Pip uses a big eyedropper on the photo and drips the colour into a cup.

sounds.name: Calligraphy pen
sounds.desc: Pip draws an SVG path with a calligraphy pen and the line smooths itself.

sounds.name: Barcode checker
sounds.desc: Pip runs a barcode under a scanner and it beeps happily.

sounds.name: Colour magician
sounds.desc: Pip pulls colour ribbons out of his sleeve, like a magician.

sounds.name: Mosaic maker
sounds.desc: Pip sticks tiles on a wall and steps back to see the picture.

sounds.name: Broom sweep
sounds.desc: Pip sweeps a pile of photos into a neat pile.

sounds.name: Matching cards
sounds.desc: Pip plays a memory game and flips two matching cards for duplicates.

sounds.name: Recycling sort
sounds.desc: Pip drops photos into three coloured bins.

sounds.name: Librarian stamps
sounds.desc: Pip stamps each photo and files it in a drawer.

sounds.name: Container ship
sounds.desc: Pip drives a little crane that loads photos on a ship.

sounds.name: Assembly line
sounds.desc: Photos roll past Pip, he checks each one and nods.

sounds.name: Many hands
sounds.desc: Pip grows four arms for a second and handles many photos at once.

sounds.name: Counting
sounds.desc: Pip counts photos on his fingers and runs out of fingers.

sounds.name: Conductor
sounds.desc: Pip conducts a row of photos like an orchestra.

sounds.name: Spring cleaning
sounds.desc: Pip opens a window, dusts the shelf and the room sparkles.

sounds.name: Graduation cap
sounds.desc: Pip puts on a graduation cap and straightens the tassel.

sounds.name: Checklist
sounds.desc: Pip ticks each requirement on a clipboard, one by one.

sounds.name: Rule check
sounds.desc: Pip measures the photo with a ruler against the exam rule and nods.

sounds.name: Signature
sounds.desc: Pip signs a tiny signature strip with a flourish.

sounds.name: Official stamp
sounds.desc: Pip stamps the photo with a round approved stamp.

sounds.name: Deadline clock
sounds.desc: Pip looks at a wall clock, relaxes, and says there is time.

sounds.name: Pack the bag
sounds.desc: Pip packs photo, signature and thumb print into a school bag and zips it.

sounds.name: Study desk
sounds.desc: Pip sits at a desk with a lamp and flips a book.

sounds.name: Pencil tap
sounds.desc: Pip taps a pencil on his head while he calculates the size.

sounds.name: Pass medal
sounds.desc: Pip hangs a small medal on the finished kit.

sounds.name: Reading
sounds.desc: Pip reads a comic and giggles at the right moment.

sounds.name: Yo-yo
sounds.desc: Pip plays with a yo-yo made from his keyring.

sounds.name: Bolt juggling
sounds.desc: Pip juggles three bolts and drops one, then shrugs.

sounds.name: Stretch
sounds.desc: Pip stretches his arms and legs and a joint clicks.

sounds.name: Yawn
sounds.desc: Pip yawns and his blade droops, then he shakes himself awake.

sounds.name: Blade polish
sounds.desc: Pip polishes his blade quiff with a cloth and checks his reflection.

sounds.name: Push-ups
sounds.desc: Pip does push-ups and counts to five.

sounds.name: Watch check
sounds.desc: Pip checks a wrist watch he does not have.

sounds.name: Little dance
sounds.desc: Pip dances in place with the keyring swinging.

sounds.name: Cat nap
sounds.desc: Pip sits down, closes his eyes and snores softly, a Z floats up.

sounds.name: Backflip
sounds.desc: Pip does a backflip and lands with a pose.

sounds.name: Cannon hold
sounds.desc: Pip holds a confetti cannon and fires it.

sounds.name: Victory dance
sounds.desc: Pip does a happy dance with arms up.

sounds.name: Tool fan
sounds.desc: All his tools fan out behind him like a peacock.

sounds.name: Self high-five
sounds.desc: Pip high-fives himself and gets a spark.

sounds.name: Moonwalk
sounds.desc: Pip moonwalks across the screen.

sounds.name: Spin tornado
sounds.desc: Pip spins like a tornado and stops dizzy but smiling.

sounds.name: Rocket jump
sounds.desc: Pip jumps so high he leaves the screen and falls back.

sounds.name: Trophy lift
sounds.desc: A trophy appears and Pip lifts it over his head.

sounds.name: Air guitar
sounds.desc: Pip plays an air guitar solo with his blade.

sounds.name: Cheerleader
sounds.desc: Pip shakes two pom-poms made from tiny blades.

sounds.name: Tool juggle
sounds.desc: Pip juggles scissors, magnifier and a crop corner.

sounds.name: Mic drop
sounds.desc: Pip drops his blade like a mic and walks away.

sounds.name: Disco
sounds.desc: A disco ball drops and Pip strikes a pose.

sounds.name: Ascend
sounds.desc: Pip rises on a column of light holding the new level medal.

sounds.name: Power up
sounds.desc: Pip grows giant for a second, flexes, then shrinks back with the medal.

sounds.name: Evolution flash
sounds.desc: A white silhouette flashes and Pip returns with a new accessory.

sounds.name: Ladder climb
sounds.desc: Pip climbs a ladder of level numbers and rings a bell at the top.

sounds.name: Rocket boost
sounds.desc: Pip straps a rocket on his back and blasts to the next level.

sounds.name: Golden blade
sounds.desc: His blade turns solid gold one section at a time.

sounds.name: Crown drop
sounds.desc: A tiny crown drops on his blade and he balances it.

sounds.name: Stair leap
sounds.desc: Pip leaps from one glowing step to the next and lands on the new level.

sounds.name: Tool transform
sounds.desc: All tools unfold and spin around Pip, then fold back.

sounds.name: Medal bite
sounds.desc: Pip bites the medal to test it, then smiles and holds it up.

sounds.name: Badge drop
sounds.desc: The badge drops from above and Pip catches it.

sounds.name: Shine reveal
sounds.desc: The badge appears under a spotlight with a shine sweep.

sounds.name: Pin on chest
sounds.desc: Pip pins the badge on his belt.

sounds.name: Coin spin
sounds.desc: The badge spins like a coin and settles.

sounds.name: Rare badge
sounds.desc: Gold flash, camera shake, big cheer. Used for gold-tier badges.

sounds.name: Flame grows
sounds.desc: The streak flame grows a size and Pip warms his hands.

sounds.name: Calendar tick
sounds.desc: A calendar page flips and the new day gets a stamp.

sounds.name: Streak saved
sounds.desc: A shield saves a streak that was about to break.

sounds.name: Streak lost
sounds.desc: The flame flickers out and Pip gives it a small hug.

sounds.name: Sad droop
sounds.desc: Pip droops, the blade bends, a small cloud rains on him.

sounds.name: Confused
sounds.desc: Pip scratches his head and question marks float up.

sounds.name: Facepalm
sounds.desc: Pip covers his face with one hand and peeks through the fingers.

sounds.name: Uh-oh
sounds.desc: Pip's eyes go wide and a sweat drop slides down.

sounds.name: Shrug
sounds.desc: Pip shrugs and holds out his empty hands.

sounds.name: Dizzy
sounds.desc: Stars circle his head.

sounds.name: Sneeze
sounds.desc: A dust bunny makes Pip sneeze, his blade flicks.

sounds.name: Hiccup
sounds.desc: Pip hiccups and a tiny bolt pops out.

sounds.name: Humming
sounds.desc: Pip hums while notes float up.

sounds.name: Peek-a-boo
sounds.desc: Pip hides behind the screen edge and peeks back in.

sounds.name: Snow day
sounds.desc: In winter, Pip shivers and wears a scarf.

sounds.name: Button tap
sounds.desc: A soft wooden tick.

sounds.name: Select
sounds.desc: A short two-note rise.

sounds.name: Switch on
sounds.desc: A short upward blip.

sounds.name: Switch off
sounds.desc: A short downward blip.

sounds.name: Back
sounds.desc: A soft downward swish.

sounds.name: Open sheet
sounds.desc: A short upward swish.

sounds.name: Close sheet
sounds.desc: A short downward swish.

sounds.name: Error
sounds.desc: Two low soft notes.

sounds.name: Success
sounds.desc: A bright two-note chime.

sounds.name: Radial menu opens
sounds.desc: Six quick pops in a ring.

sounds.name: Radial menu pick
sounds.desc: A satisfying click-pop.

sounds.name: File dropped
sounds.desc: A paper thud.

sounds.name: Photo picked
sounds.desc: A soft shutter.

sounds.name: Copied
sounds.desc: A tiny blip.

sounds.name: Share sheet
sounds.desc: A swoosh up.

sounds.name: Warning
sounds.desc: A hollow double note.

sounds.name: Job starts
sounds.desc: A rising riser.

sounds.name: Job done
sounds.desc: A chime and a click.

sounds.name: XP gained
sounds.desc: A bright coin ping with the +XP text.

sounds.name: Quest done

sounds.name: All quests done
sounds.desc: A rising arpeggio.

sounds.name: Chest shakes
sounds.desc: A wooden rattle.

sounds.name: Chest opens
sounds.desc: A creak, a burst and a magic glide.

sounds.name: Award appears
sounds.desc: A shiny reveal.

sounds.name: Rank up
sounds.desc: A short fanfare.

sounds.name: Locked item tapped
sounds.desc: A dull knock and a tiny shake.

sounds.name: Trophy added
sounds.desc: A heavy shiny clink.

sounds.name: Skin unlocked
sounds.desc: A magic swish and a ping.

sounds.name: Daily bonus
sounds.desc: A friendly hello jingle.

sounds.desc: A squeaky ouch.

sounds.desc: A quick giggle.

sounds.name: Giggle 2
sounds.desc: A longer giggle.

sounds.name: Giggle 3
sounds.desc: A snort giggle.

sounds.name: Oops
sounds.desc: A falling oops.

sounds.name: Squeal
sounds.desc: A short squeal when lifted.

sounds.name: Whee
sounds.desc: A flying whee.

sounds.desc: A yawn into a snore.

sounds.name: Raspberry
sounds.desc: A wet raspberry.

sounds.name: Nibble
sounds.desc: A chomp chomp.

sounds.desc: An annoyed grumble.

sounds.name: Big cheer
sounds.desc: A longer cheer for big wins.

sounds.name: Sad
sounds.desc: A soft sad whine.

sounds.name: Ear bell left
sounds.desc: A bell note.

sounds.name: Ear bell right

sounds.desc: A short lift squeak.
